card.title: ROYAL SCOTS
card.text: If in hand or on the battlefield, random effects always choose this unit.
card.flavorText: The Royal Scots Regiment was first raised in 1633 and existed until 2006 when it became the Royal Scottish Borderers. At the start of WWII the 1st Battalion of the Royal Scots was part of the British Expeditionary Force and fought in the Battle of France prior to being evacuated at Dunkirk. After Dunkirk the 1st Royal Scots worked on home defense preparations, but in 1942 they were sent to British India from where they would fight in the Burma Campaign. The 2nd Battalion was in Gibraltar in 1943 from where it was moved to Italy to participate in the Italian Campaign in 1944. The 2nd Royal Scots saw action in the Battle of Anzio and on the Gothic Line.  The 7th/9th Battalion was moved to the Netherlands in 1944 and participated in the  Battle of the Scheldt and later Operation Bluecoat followed by the advance across the Rhine and to Bremen by the end of the war. The 8th Battalion remained in the UK until it participated in the Normandy landings in 1944 and fought in a series of offensive battles and operations, from Paris to the Rhine, and were advancing to Hamburg when the war ended.
